history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

classes-1800-small-paladins.description: The Paladin starts of classes-1800-small (borg-zoo#544): each with its classes-1800 character, for class-specific studies.

experiment.description: Does lowering the Paladin's DL3-4 maximum-HP gate from 50 to 45 let Paladins reach DL3 and DL5 sooner without new deaths? Generated from definitions/reborn-paladin-gate-pilot.yaml: 2 arms on 4.2.6-reborn-rust-paladin-gate-2fdfd41c, suite classes-1800-small-paladins.
experiment.name: reborn-paladin-gate-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-21: zoo owner, "do all of those" (the ideas offered) and the borg-reborn-rs request #795 (proposal for owner review). Pilots and small runs, all classes; the Rangers are set aside.
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-21, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#544). Pilot on the 10 Paladin starts, already
read in #522, so the mechanism check, not confirmation (a fresh Paladin block is the owner's to open).
Gate: no config_error; one binary; the value in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped.
Report: alive at the cap having reached DL5 (primary); time to first DL3 and DL5 with dead or unfinished starts
visible; all deaths; rescued and newly killed pairs; mean CL and max depth; refusals at 45-49 observed max HP (does hp45
change them?) from the retained traces. Proposed guardrail: no more than 2 points of survival lost at the cap.
experiment.question: Does lowering the Paladin's DL3-4 maximum-HP gate from 50 to 45 let Paladins reach DL3 and DL5 sooner without new deaths?
